decisive_finding.cause: IsolationLease retains only a PathBuf. Cleanup and recovery recursively remove whichever regular directory currently occupies that path without comparing the acquired lease root device and inode or using no-follow descriptor-relative traversal.
decisive_finding.impact: An attacker or race can replace the lease path with unrelated data and cause recovery to delete it. Collision, cleanup, recovery, filesystem-race, and data-loss confinement semantics therefore remain false.

executable_reproduction.attack: rename the real lease root aside; create an unrelated replacement directory and sentinel at the original path; invoke recover
executable_reproduction.observed: recover returned CausalFailure and deleted the unrelated replacement sentinel
executable_reproduction.baseline: The independently reproduced Darwin suite passed 29 of 29, proving the accepted-looking suite omitted this attack.

corrective_lease.required_result: Pin the acquired lease-root identity and perform no-follow race-safe cleanup/recovery that refuses replacement roots and child substitutions; add deterministic root and concurrent swap red controls.
